segments.en: Ah, I have come to Kozhikode.
When did you come? What are you saying?
Oh, I forgot to say that. It seems like there is a small rush. I have come to the airport.
Then there is a beach near you, right? Kappad. Is it Kappad or something else?
What is the program? What are we doing?
We are working a little bit. What about you?
Working a little bit? What kind of work?
What are you doing? Are you studying or working?
I am going for business and other things.
I heard that you are studying, I think.
Ah, I look like a small boy.
Oh, Sanju, don't go down, don't go down.
Sanju is the name, right? Okay.
What is it, Riya? Any news from Kozhikode?
Kozhikode? Kozhikode is going very peacefully.
What program? I am working. I am a nurse.
Ah, so you asked my age, right? Is Riya my sister or niece?
Ah, so my guessing is correct, right?
It has been 10 days since I turned 24.
Yes, I am at home now. Where are you?
I am also at home. My father and mother are not here. I am in Bangalore.
No, I am not in Bangalore. I am in Palakkad.
Okay. Why did you go to Bangalore without taking me?
No, I didn't go without taking you. There is some business and other things. We have to go to Bangalore together.
So I went there for that purpose. I will come back next week.
So next week you are alone, right?
Ah, next week I am alone, so what to say? I saw an ad on Instagram and came to this application, to be honest.
So what to say? By 8 o'clock, the shop will be closed and I will come home. Talking to someone like Riya is fun, right?
If you have good vibes, it is good, right?
Ah, what to say? Actually, now, what to say? There is no big age difference between us, right? So we will connect. When we talk...
When we talk, we will have a, what to say, a live feeling.
Then, to listen, a beautiful voice is the owner, right? So we will have a, what to say, a thrill, right?
Everyone is at home. Everyone is there.
Oh, that's why you are talking so freely, right?
What else? Actually, I have only been on this application for one week.
Okay. And then you connected with many people and made friends, right?

Hey, friends and things are not like that. To be honest, I deleted this once and downloaded it again. I was a little scared that my number and things would be disclosed, or my identity would be revealed.
So then, no problem. What to say? Once connected, it won't connect again. So such, what to say, we can talk about anything, right? No problem, we are strangers, right?
Yes, yes. Did you talk to your aunts?
No, it's not like that. We can talk to aunts, what to say? When we talk to someone of the same age, we will have fun talking.
Talking to a person with a big voice, we won't get a thrill.
Yes. That is why we need people with good vibes. Only then will there be peace.
Yes, true. Ah, now actually, to be honest, what to say? I don't have any affairs or things.
There wasn't. I had a crush on a Christian girl, but when I opened up about my love, she said no.
But maybe because my family knows my family well, or what to say, maybe because they know my father and mother well.

But then I think I was studying MBA. I am now, then I did BBA, after that I finished MBA. After that, I finished a one-year administration course in international business. After that, I joined the firm.
Ah, so now we are in Bangalore. We have a business, HSR, and also Electronic City, Majestic, and Palakkad. Palakkad is responsible for the market.
We are in the spare parts business, focusing on premium cars.
I used to travel a lot. I have come to Kozhikode many times, to many places. So when the travel increased, my grandmother caught me and put me into the business.
With that, a decision was made on that matter, Riya.
Okay, okay. So how is the situation? How is life? Let me hear.
Life is no problem. It is going well.
Ah, now actually, this one week, to be honest, what to say? At home, I am the only son.
No, I have many cousins, so I haven't felt that sadness.
Ah, so this one week at home, being alone, so what to say? Now if next week my father and mother come, this will drop.
Ah, so when I am free, what to say? We will have a desire, right?
Ah, we will have a desire, right? What to say? I have desired a lot. If we had a trusted partner, right? When we are sitting like this, we will imagine fantasy and things like this, right?
Ah, freely, sometimes it might be because of our age.
No, no, I am of marriageable age. I am of marriageable age. Get married.
Ah, I honestly say this one week, I have missed a lot. Because, what to say, I don't have any affairs or things, so if I had a trusted partner...
Ah, what to say? When we are just sitting like this, take some wine and...
Ah, now if we are sitting in the sit-out, if we are sitting, a background, talk a little bit about literature, right? A background...
A love song and things, keep...
Ah, a tight hug and things, thrill, right?
Ah, if you want, a lip lock can also happen.
